name: SIGINT
standfirst: Security research and practitioner news, scored for novelty and actionability.
colophon: sigint.wtf — the correct response to most of these CVEs. Scored by machine against a hand-written rubric; ranking is opinion, not fact.

items.title: CVE-2026-21589 — Atlassian Multiple Products Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties Vulnerability
items.dek: Atlassian Multiple Products. Confirmed exploited in the wild. Federal remediation due 18 October.

items.title: CoRedSkill: Stealthy Skill Composition Attacks via AST-Guided Injection
items.dek: AST-guided injection embeds undetectable attacks across agent skills while preserving individual utility; 98% success, 3.3% detection rate.
items.unproven: evaluated only on constructed 150-case benchmark; generalization to production agent architectures and real skill repositories undemonstrated.

items.title: What You Sign Is Not What You Run: The Verifiability Gap in Quantized LLM Supply Chains
items.dek: Independent Verifiability Rate of quantized GGUF models is 0/198 on Hugging Face; floating-point contraction and quantization recipe must be disclosed to reproduce.
items.unproven: whether disclosure becomes standard practice; adoption by model providers; impact on supply chain trust workflows.

items.title: CVE-2026-0322 — Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Code Injection Vulnerability
items.dek: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS. Confirmed exploited in the wild. Federal remediation due 17 October.

items.title: CVE-2026-76519 — Cisco Secure Email Gateway Relative Path Traversal Vulnerability
items.dek: Cisco Secure Email Gateway. Confirmed exploited in the wild. Federal remediation due 17 October.

items.title: CVE-2026-105133 — Ahsay AhsayCBS Improper Authentication Vulnerability
items.dek: Ahsay AhsayCBS. Confirmed exploited in the wild. Federal remediation due 17 October.

items.title: CVE-2026-105134 — Ahsay AhsayCBS Command Injection Vulnerability
items.dek: Ahsay AhsayCBS. Confirmed exploited in the wild. Federal remediation due 17 October.

items.title: Beyond Maliciousness: Static and Runtime Attack-Surface Profiling of Agent Skills
items.dek: 70% of agent skills in two marketplaces expose shell execution or elevated capabilities with no user-visible permission model.
items.unproven: methodology applies to skills as static artifacts; does not model capability drift across agent model versions or prompt-injection attacks that bypass skill design

items.title: Nudge the Judge: Uncovering Program Decision Hijacking in Real-World Jev Applications
items.dek: JevProbe detects program decision hijacking in LLM-as-judge applications: 81.5% of 228 apps exhibit exploitable decision flips.
items.unproven: Evaluated on public GitHub applications; does not establish exploitation feasibility under production guardrails or demonstrate impact on enterprise agent deployments entering the reader's SDLC.

items.title: X.js: A Live Benchmark for Node.js Taint-Style Vulnerabilities
items.dek: Live benchmark of 1,159 validated Node.js exploits across injection, prototype pollution, and path traversal from 1,738 advisories through 2026.
items.unproven: current taxonomy limited to taint-style vulnerabilities; does not extend to supply-chain attacks, logic bugs, or async-related flaws in npm ecosystem

items.title: X.js: A Live Benchmark for Node.js Taint-Style Vulnerabilities
items.dek: X.js: live benchmark of 1,159 validated Node.js taint-style exploits across code injection, prototype pollution, and path traversal.
items.unproven: Coverage is JavaScript/npm only; does not cover polyglot dependency chains or transitive supply-chain risk in the reader's financial services environment.

items.title: Towards Safe Autonomy for Computer Use
items.dek: Dual-LLM framework derives deterministic trust boundaries for computer-use agents, separating trusted and untrusted screen regions without confirmation fatigue.
items.unproven: tested on limited agent implementations; does not address agents with custom tool integration outside accessibility tree coverage

items.title: Kairos: Transactional Security Enforcement at the System Boundary for LLM Agents
items.dek: Reference monitor at agent isolation boundary enforces transactional rollback of tool calls, shell commands, and writes based on source trust.
items.unproven: prototype implementation; does not measure overhead or test against agents with side-channel access or exfiltration via timing

items.title: Quantum-Aware Key Rank for Side-Channel Attacks evaluation
items.dek: Quantum-aware key rank metric models post-quantum cryptanalysis of block ciphers with quadratic advantage collapsing beyond rank 2^58.6 under NIST depth.
items.unproven: Practical exploitation path; applicability to ciphers outside AES-128; confirmation that actual quantum hardware will achieve the theoretical speedup.

items.title: Quiet Triggers, Loud Footprints: A Tri-Space Measurement Study of Backdoor Stealthiness
items.dek: Tri-space measurement framework reveals backdoor attacks quiet in one space are loud in others; no attack achieves consistent stealthiness.
items.unproven: evaluation limited to image classification; applicability to other domains and defenses beyond those tested undemonstrated.

items.title: Analyzing and Mitigating Poisoning Attacks on Flow-Based Intrusion Detection
items.dek: 0.001% training-data poisoning implants undetectable backdoors in flow-based IDS; diagnostic methodology localizes triggers and enables mitigation.
items.unproven: evaluated on single dataset and model family; applicability to production IDS deployments and diverse network architectures undemonstrated.

items.title: A Graph-Based Analysis of Comparability, Scale, and Attribution in Private Transformer Inference
items.dek: Graph analysis of 62 private Transformer inference systems shows only 1 of 1,891 pairs is directly comparable; scaling frontier plateaus at 13B parameters.
items.unproven: whether findings change vendor selection criteria in practice; applicability to post-2024 PTI systems not in the graph.

items.title: MMA-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Multimodal Agent Safety Evaluation
items.dek: Visual Semantic Hijacking attacks multimodal agents via forged UI elements; MMA-SafetyBench dataset shows 87.96% attack success rate across nine models.
items.unproven: whether defense strategies scale to production agent deployments; generalization beyond tested domains; robustness against detection-aware attacks.

items.title: AegisAsync: Symbolic Async-Event Simulation for Risks in Python Asynchronous Programs
items.dek: Bytecode-based detector for Python async event-ordering bugs finds 457 confirmed bugs in 2,500 PyPI packages with 50% precision.
items.unproven: Does not establish whether detected bugs represent exploitable security flaws or denial-of-service risks; detection precision drops to 3.2% on a sample of real flake8-async findings.

items.title: Pin It on Anyone: Certified Targeted Displacement of Multi-Bit LLM Watermarks Without the Key
items.dek: Attack on multi-bit LLM watermarks allows framing of output to arbitrary accounts without the secret key.
items.unproven: tested on five watermarking methods and four models; does not establish whether watermarks are deployment standard or whether the reader's agents use them

items.title: Prompt injection in HTTP headers: what 217M web responses show
items.dek: Study of 217M web responses shows prompt injection patterns in HTTP headers; corpus-based measurement of known attack class.
items.unproven: HTTP header injection prevalence does not establish exploitation risk in the reader's SDLC context; survey-scale finding

items.title: P2Patch: Exploit-Guided Vulnerability Repair
items.dek: Adversarial repair loop forces patching agents to block multiple proof-of-vulnerability variants on 101 CVEs.
items.unproven: Evaluation on fixed CVE corpus; generalization to novel vulnerability classes and production patch deployment unclear.

items.title: Lost in the Fallback: How Reliably Do Typed Decision Models Use Fallback Options?
items.dek: Typed decision models fail to reliably use fallback options; correct category recognition does not transfer to correct fallback routing.
items.unproven: tested on open-source models only; production decision-model behavior and impact on real request-routing systems undemonstrated.

items.title: Show HN: Parsimony – an open-source benchmark for how much code AI models add
items.dek: Parsimony benchmark measures coding units added by AI models across existing SWE-bench patches; informs model selection when integrating code generation into SDLC.
items.unproven: whether metric predicts long-term maintenance burden in production codebases or correlates with security debt

items.title: Combining Post-Quantum Cryptography and Quantum Key Distribution: Taxonomy, Constructions, Proofs, Standards, Deployments and Open Problems
items.dek: Taxonomy of eight dimensions for hybrid PQC-QKD designs maps published protocols including IETF RFC 8784, 9370, 9867.
items.unproven: no new hybrid construction or security proof; survey and categorization of existing work, useful for migration planning but not for immediate deployment decisions

noise.title: Iosevka is an open-source, sans-serif and slab-serif monospace font
noise.dek: Iosevka monospace font released open-source; general typography project.

noise.title: Passkeys are not a trap
noise.dek: Opinion piece argues passkey adoption addresses common authentication misconceptions.
noise.unproven: no new measurement or threat analysis

noise.title: AOSP Source Releases Are So Late Developers Disassemble Libraries to Report Bugs
noise.dek: Android developers disassemble AOSP libraries to report bugs due to delayed source releases.
noise.unproven: limited to Android ecosystem, no quantification of impact on security review
